heard: Roald Amundsen told the world he was sailing for the North Pole. In September 1910, he secretly turned his ship toward Antarctica. By October 1911, five men and 52 dogs began the march. High on a glacier, the team finally ran out of food. Amundsen slaughtered his own dogs to feed the survivors. On December 14th, they reached the pole weeks before Scott. Only 11 dogs survived the 99-day journey. The world still thought they were sailing for the North Pole.
